body:
In addition to the changes below, upgraded to [rustsec 0.34](https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/releases/tag/rustsec%2Fv0.34.0).

## What's Changed

* cargo-audit: suggest unaffected newer versions by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1619
* Set user agent for index clients by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1625
* Report in JSON which warnings --deny promotes to errors by @Eljees in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1671
* cargo-audit: add cargo-binstall metadata so prebuilt release binaries are used by @0xdea in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1731
* docs(cargo-audit): explain target platform value discovery by @jdotc1 in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1726
* audit: add update-db subcommand by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1735
* audit: remove dependency on abscissa by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1737
* fix(cargo-audit)!: Remove extra dot in `advisory-db..lock` by @hashcatHitman in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1744
* audit: show potential solutions for warnings as well by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1745
* audit: re-enable regression test by @djc in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1736
